context: A uni student presents a history paper on local autonomy
purpose: Teach: 分権/入札/海軍/排出/大気/中略/省略/ビザ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、今日の発表テーマは「明治期における地方分権の試み」です。よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: Professor, today's presentation topic is 'attempts at local decentralization in the Meiji era.' Thank you in advance.
lines.style: Formal academic opening, polite student tone with slight nervousness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はい、楽しみにしていましたよ。レジュメは長くなりそうなら一部省略してもいいですからね。
lines.en: Yes, I've been looking forward to it. If the handout gets too long, it's fine to omit some parts.
lines.style: Warm encouraging teacher tone, mature feminine register with gentle authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。まず当時の公共事業の入札制度を通じて、中央と地方の力関係を分析しました。
lines.en: Thank you. First, I analyzed the power dynamic between central and local governments through the bidding system for public works.
lines.style: Earnest academic delivery, measured pace as student presenting findings.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 面白い切り口ですね。当時は海軍の拡張に予算が集中していましたが、その影響にも触れていますか?
lines.en: An interesting angle. Back then the budget was concentrated on naval expansion—have you touched on that impact?
lines.style: Inquisitive teacher voice, probing deeper into the analysis thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、詳しい数字は中略しましたが、軍事費の膨張が地方財政を圧迫した点は資料3に示してあります。
lines.en: Yes, I abridged the detailed figures, but the point about military spending squeezing local finances is shown in handout three.
lines.style: Composed academic explanation, confident citing evidence after gentle abridgment note.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。現代の自治体が大気汚染の排出規制を独自に決められる流れとも、比較できそうですね。
lines.en: I see. It seems comparable to how modern municipalities can independently decide air pollution emission regulations.
lines.style: Bridging past to present, engaged scholarly curiosity drawing a natural parallel.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まさにそこを論じたかったんです。明治期より現代の自治体の方が、排出基準などで自律性が高いと考えます。
lines.en: That's exactly what I wanted to discuss. Modern municipalities have higher autonomy than the Meiji era, in things like emission standards.
lines.style: Confident comparative argument, gaining momentum and presentation rhythm.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い視点です。来月の国際学会で発表してみませんか?ビザの申請も早めに進めるといいですよ。
lines.en: Good perspective. Why don't you try presenting at the international conference next month? You should start the visa application early too.
lines.style: Encouraging mentor shifting to practical advice, warm professional support.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: えっ、本当ですか?ビザはまだですが、急いで準備します。ありがとうございます!
lines.en: Huh, really? The visa isn't done yet, but I'll prepare quickly. Thank you so much!
lines.style: Surprised then excited student, gratitude bursting through formal restraint.
